study.question: Does the small gain from linear position moments require within-relation variation of weighted event content, or can the average position of target-matching events multiplying existing content explain it?
study.hypothesis: Separating relation occupancy timing from within-relation weighted-content variation yields a less confounded representation unit. The centered component may retain the useful fine-order signal without an average-match-position term; this predicts a useful within-only candidate. This is a prospective hypothesis, not established mechanism support.

nearest_work.difference: Immediate local comparator mixes mean relation position and within-relation weighted-content variation in one projected first moment; decompose exactly into these components while retaining the token and readout architecture.

Archived original primary text lines250-283 establishes target-conditioned unnormalized pooling; inherited pooling remains, but moments are composed inside temporal/target-relation tokens with joint interaction. No exact-paper reproduction claim.

Pinned benchmark forward/block inspected lines125-224: local compression, recent queries and cross/self attention. Here keep the local parent network and decompose a fixed rank moment; no local Transformers or repeated long/recent exchanges are adopted. paper:longer is link-only; original-method novelty remains unverified.

Pinned benchmark forward lines175-199 flattens sequence and fields before tokenization. Here maintain compressed relation tokens and isolate their positional information; no flattened-sequence projection. paper:unimixer is link-only.

Accessible author README only documents category/brand/behavior data without item; unavailable publisher mechanism text cannot support an originality claim. Current inputs explicitly contain previous ad IDs.

inherited_components: Entire g0-r0005-linear_moment architecture, dimensions, initialization order, shared zero-init moment projection and linear coefficient normalization
DIN field/task adaptation, embeddings, learned signed target-history weights and global history bypass
Five temporal bins crossed with seven overlapping global/encoded-field target relations, logarithmic counts, token identities and temporal-only validity
One shared joint token block and four unchanged task towers; default sum of unweighted BCEs
study.proposed_difference: For each temporal/relation unit R, retain c as the parent linear rank coefficient centered/RMS-normalized over its temporal bin. Set mu_R=sum_R(c)/max(|R|,1), S_R=sum_R(w*v)/sqrt(7), M_R=sum_R(c*w*v)/sqrt(7). Define occupancy O_R=mu_R*S_R and centered W_R=M_R-O_R. Four arms pass M, W, O or zero through the SAME inherited moment_projection into the SAME tokens. Compute M, S, O and W in FP32 in every arm. Empty relations give zero; singleton relations have W=0 in exact arithmetic. No division by signed activation sums, extra projection, raw time, new feedback or loss. This is a diagnostic representation replacement, with no verified priority claim.
predictions: Source-level identity M=W+O holds within numerical tolerance, including signed weights, overlapping relations and sparse/no matches. W cancels constant weighted values; O keeps relation timing multiplying the existing summary.

If within-relation weighted-content order drives the prior result, within_centered should exceed zero_component and occupancy_timing in validation macro AUC; full_replay should exceed occupancy_timing when W is added.

If occupancy timing suffices, occupancy_timing should retain most of the full-vs-zero gain and within_centered should lose that gain. This supports the alternative, not the centered-content hypothesis.

The four-arm contrast Y(full)-Y(within)-Y(occupancy)+Y(zero) diagnoses a nonadditive interaction under a tied projection; it is not an algebraic prediction about AUC. No independent-projection conclusion follows.

Exploratory history-length diagnostics may localize gains, but no direct per-example position benefit can be inferred in empty histories where the added input is zero. Report all task AUC/Logloss changes and existing slice counts.
falsifiers: Within-only fails to improve over occupancy-only/zero and adding W to O does not help: usefulness of the centered representation is unsupported under this implementation and recipe.

All active arms match or underperform zero or the previous copy_moment control: extra positional information has no established advantage beyond reparameterization. Do not treat a single-seed null as refuting all sequence mechanisms.

Full replay fails tolerance checks against g0-r0005-linear_moment common-state outputs/gradients or zero replay against g0-r0005-zero_moment: investigate execution/precision/RNG differences before interpreting empirical deltas.
Paired validation repetitions reverse the candidate/control ordering: retain preliminary or null evidence and do not attribute a reliable mechanism.

Unnormalized signed activation weights depend on content, so centered residual includes activation-position association and is not pure embedding covariance
Overlapping relation tokens and shared parameters can transfer gains to empty-history cases; auxiliary labels are category/brand matches rather than ad-specific conversions

The centroid multiplies the existing learned summary, so occupancy-only is a positional gating control, not a scalar-only count feature. Global relation centroid is zero in exact arithmetic; differences arise for restricted relations.

No closed assessment was consulted.
